title: EP-Governance Policy
description: Schema for a governance policy that governs agent transitions within the EP-Governance lattice.

id.description: Unique 20-char lowercase base32hex identifier for this policy.

effect.description: The effect this policy has when matched.

actions.description: List of action strings this policy applies to.

resources.description: List of resource strings this policy applies to.

conditions.description: Condition object evaluated to determine if the policy matches a transition.

priority.description: Priority of this policy. Higher values take precedence.

scope.description: The scope at which this policy applies: global, project, branch, or agent.

agent_scope.description: Agent XID when scope=agent; null otherwise.

project_id.description: Project XID when scope=project; null otherwise.

branch_id.description: Branch XID when scope=branch; null otherwise.

created_by.description: XID of the principal that created this policy.

approved_by.description: XID of the principal that approved this policy. Null if not yet approved.

approved_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of approval. Null if not yet approved.

activation_version.description: The lattice version at which this policy became active. Null if not yet active.

exception_to.description: List of policy XIDs that this policy is an exception to.

valid_from.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp from which this policy is valid. Null if always valid.

valid_until.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp until which this policy is valid. Null if no expiry.

justification.description: Justification for this policy or exception. Null if not applicable.
